subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth connection diagnostics may the Control UI expose and make copyable without weakening the auth, device, and privacy boundary?
rationale: The central request is useful, but it intentionally surfaces handshake, device identity, close, and auth failure details before a trusted session exists, so automation should not choose the disclosure/redaction policy alone.

options.title: Sanitized client-only diagnostics
options.body: Expose only sanitized client-side connection timing phases, close codes, redacted error details, and copy support before auth, then keep logs.tail for post-auth use.

options.title: Authenticated full diagnostics
options.body: Keep pre-auth UI to categorized failure guidance and expose richer gateway logs only after authentication and operator.read are available.

options.title: Support export workflow
options.body: Design a broader support-export action that combines redacted client diagnostics with authenticated gateway log tails under explicit user consent.

recommendation.title: Sanitized client-only diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose only sanitized client-side connection timing phases, close codes, redacted error details, and copy support before auth, then keep logs.tail for post-auth use.

likelyOwner.reason: The disconnected login gate and auth-adjacent UI recovery path are the central placement and disclosure boundary for this decision.
